ko.title: 다시 돌아오는 시간: 영구적인 일광 절약 시간제 논쟁이 제자리걸음인 이유

segments.src: Every autumn, Americans gain an hour of sleep and lose an hour of evening light.
segments.tr: 매년 가을, 미국인들은 한 시간의 수면을 얻고 저녁의 한 시간 빛을 잃습니다.

segments.src: With clocks having just turned back for the year, a familiar question returns: why are we still doing this twice a year?
segments.tr: 올해 시계가 막 뒤로 돌아간 지금, 익숙한 질문이 다시 돌아옵니다. 왜 우리는 여전히 일 년에 두 번씩 이런 일을 반복하고 있을까요?

segments.src: Polls regularly show that many Americans would like to stop changing the clocks.
segments.tr: 여론조사는 많은 미국인이 시계 변경을 멈추고 싶어 한다는 것을 정기적으로 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Yet years of bills, hearings and statehouse debates have produced no national change.
segments.tr: 하지만 수년간의 법안, 청문회, 주의회 토론에도 불구하고 국가적인 변화는 없었습니다.

segments.src: The reason has less to do with indifference than with a disagreement over which time to keep.
segments.tr: 그 이유는 무관심보다는 어떤 시간을 유지할지에 대한 의견 불일치와 더 관련이 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Where the Law Stands
segments.tr: ## 법적 현황

segments.src: Under the Uniform Time Act of 1966, states may opt out of daylight saving time and stay on standard time all year.
segments.tr: 1966년 통일 시간법(Uniform Time Act)에 따라 주(state)들은 일광 절약 시간제(daylight saving time)를 선택하지 않고 일 년 내내 표준시를 유지할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Arizona (apart from the Navajo Nation) and Hawaii have done so.
segments.tr: 애리조나(나바호 네이션 제외)와 하와이가 그렇게 했습니다.

segments.src: States cannot, however, adopt permanent daylight saving time on their own.
segments.tr: 그러나 주들이 독자적으로 영구적인 일광 절약 시간제를 채택할 수는 없습니다.

segments.src: That change requires an act of Congress.
segments.tr: 그 변화를 위해서는 의회의 법안이 필요합니다.

segments.src: Dozens of states have passed laws or resolutions that would move to year-round daylight time if Congress allowed it.
segments.tr: 수십 개의 주가 의회가 허용한다면 연중 일광 절약 시간제로 전환하겠다는 법률이나 결의안을 통과시켰습니다.

segments.src: These measures are often called "trigger" laws because they take effect only after federal permission.
segments.tr: 이러한 조치들은 연방 정부의 허가가 있어야만 발효되기 때문에 종종 "트리거(trigger)" 법안이라고 불립니다.

segments.src: This leaves a patchwork of intentions with no clear path forward.
segments.tr: 이로 인해 명확한 해결책 없이 의도만 뒤섞인 상황이 남게 되었습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bill That Almost Was
segments.tr: ## 거의 성사될 뻔했던 법안

segments.src: The best-known attempt was the Sunshine Protection Act.
segments.tr: 가장 잘 알려진 시도는 '햇빛 보호법(Sunshine Protection Act)'이었습니다.

segments.src: In March 2022 the Senate passed it by unanimous consent, with little debate.
segments.tr: 2022년 3월 상원은 토론 없이 만장일치로 이 법안을 통과시켰습니다.

segments.src: The bill would have made daylight saving time permanent nationwide.
segments.tr: 이 법안은 전국적으로 일광 절약 시간제를 영구화할 예정이었습니다.

segments.src: The House did not take it up, and the bill expired at the end of that session.
segments.tr: 하원은 이를 다루지 않았고, 해당 회기 말에 법안은 폐기되었습니다.

segments.src: Versions have been reintroduced in later Congresses with bipartisan sponsors, and they have again stalled in committee.
segments.tr: 이후 의회에서 초당적인 후원자들과 함께 법안의 수정안들이 다시 제출되었지만, 위원회에서 다시 교착 상태에 빠졌습니다.

segments.src: The 2022 episode is often cited as proof of how popular the idea is.
segments.tr: 2022년의 사건은 이 아이디어가 얼마나 인기가 있는지를 보여주는 증거로 자주 인용됩니다.

segments.src: It also showed how little consensus lay beneath the surface.
segments.tr: 또한 표면 아래에 합의가 얼마나 부족했는지도 보여주었습니다.

segments.src: Several senators later said they had not examined the details, and some critics argued the chamber had acted without a serious look at the evidence.
segments.tr: 나중에 여러 상원의원은 세부 사항을 검토하지 않았다고 말했으며, 일부 비평가들은 의회가 증거를 진지하게 검토하지 않고 행동했다고 주장했습니다.

segments.src: ## The Case for Permanent Daylight Time
segments.tr: ## 영구적인 일광 절약 시간제를 지지하는 이유

segments.src: Supporters of year-round daylight time point to several benefits:
segments.tr: 연중 일광 절약 시간제를 지지하는 사람들은 몇 가지 이점을 지적합니다:

segments.src: - **Evening light.** Later sunsets year-round mean more daylight after work and school, which supporters say encourages outdoor activity, shopping and recreation.
segments.tr: - **저녁의 빛.** 일 년 내내 늦게 해가 지면 퇴근과 하교 후에 더 많은 낮 시간이 생기며, 지지자들은 이것이 야외 활동, 쇼핑, 레크리에이션을 장려한다고 말합니다.

segments.src: - **Safety.** Some studies suggest that more evening light can reduce certain crimes and may lower the risk of pedestrian crashes during the evening commute, when traffic is heavy.
segments.tr: - **안전.** 일부 연구에 따르면 저녁에 빛이 더 많으면 특정 범죄를 줄일 수 있고, 교통량이 많은 저녁 퇴근 시간대에 보행자 사고 위험을 낮출 수 있다고 합니다.

segments.src: - **Economic activity.** Retail, restaurant and tourism groups have long backed extra daylight hours, arguing that consumers spend more when it is light out.
segments.tr: - **경제 활동.** 소매, 식당 및 관광 업계는 오랫동안 낮 시간이 길어지는 것을 지지해 왔으며, 밖이 밝을 때 소비자가 더 많이 지출한다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: - **No more switching.** Ending the twice-yearly change removes the disruption it causes, including a short-term rise in some health and safety problems around the spring shift.
segments.tr: - **더 이상의 시간 변경 없음.** 일 년에 두 번씩 시간을 바꾸는 것을 끝내면 봄철 시간 변경 전후에 발생하는 일부 건강 및 안전 문제의 단기적인 증가를 포함하여 그로 인한 혼란을 제거할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Case for Permanent Standard Time
segments.tr: ## 영구적인 표준시를 지지하는 이유

segments.src: Many sleep scientists and medical groups favor the opposite approach.
segments.tr: 많은 수면 과학자와 의료 단체는 정반대의 접근 방식을 선호합니다.

segments.src: The American Academy of Sleep Medicine and other professional bodies have said that permanent standard time better matches the human body clock, because it aligns more closely with the natural cycle of sunrise and sunset.
segments.tr: 미국 수면 의학회(American Academy of Sleep Medicine)와 기타 전문 기관들은 영구적인 표준시가 일출과 일몰의 자연스러운 주기와 더 밀접하게 일치하기 때문에 인체의 생체 시계와 더 잘 맞는다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Their main points are:
segments.tr: 그들의 주요 주장은 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: - **Circadian health.** Standard time puts more light in the morning, which helps regulate sleep and alertness. Permanent daylight time would mean very late sunrises in winter, especially in the western parts of time zones. In some places the sun would not rise until well after 8 a.m.
segments.tr: - **일주기 건강.** 표준시는 아침에 더 많은 빛을 제공하여 수면과 각성 상태를 조절하는 데 도움을 줍니다. 영구적인 일광 절약 시간제는 겨울철, 특히 시간대의 서쪽 지역에서 매우 늦은 일출을 의미하게 됩니다. 일부 지역에서는 오전 8시가 훨씬 넘어서야 해가 뜰 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Sleep and long-term health.** Researchers have linked chronic misalignment between social clocks and the body clock with sleep loss and other health problems. Advocates say standard time is the safer bet.
segments.tr: - **수면 및 장기적 건강.** 연구자들은 사회적 시간과 생체 시계 사이의 만성적인 불일치가 수면 부족 및 기타 건강 문제와 관련이 있다고 지적했습니다. 옹호자들은 표준시가 더 안전한 선택이라고 말합니다.

segments.src: - **School mornings.** Children would commonly wait for buses and walk to school in the dark during winter months under permanent daylight time.
segments.tr: - **등교 시간.** 영구적인 일광 절약 시간제 하에서는 겨울철에 아이들이 어둠 속에서 버스를 기다리고 학교까지 걸어가야 할 것입니다.

segments.src: Evidence on both sides is real but imperfect.
segments.tr: 양측의 증거는 실재하지만 완벽하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Studies vary in method and in geography, and a benefit in one region can be a cost in another.
segments.tr: 연구마다 방법과 지리적 위치가 다르며, 한 지역에서의 이점이 다른 지역에서는 비용이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Lessons From the Past
segments.tr: ## 과거로부터의 교훈

segments.src: The United States has tried this before.
segments.tr: 미국은 이전에 이를 시도한 적이 있습니다.

segments.src: In 1974, Congress enacted year-round daylight time as a response to the energy crisis.
segments.tr: 1974년, 의회는 에너지 위기에 대응하여 연중 일광 절약 시간제를 시행했습니다.

segments.src: Early public support faded within months as winter mornings stayed dark, and Congress reversed course the following year.
segments.tr: 겨울 아침이 어두운 상태로 유지되자 초기 대중의 지지는 몇 달 만에 사라졌고, 의회는 이듬해에 방침을 뒤집었습니다.

segments.src: Supporters of permanence say today's circumstances are different.
segments.tr: 영구화를 지지하는 사람들은 오늘날의 상황은 다르다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Critics say the episode is a warning.
segments.tr: 비평가들은 그 사건이 경고라고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## Why Nothing Gets Done
segments.tr: ## 왜 아무것도 이루어지지 않는가

segments.src: If both parties like the idea of ending clock changes, why is there no law?
segments.tr: 양당 모두 시간 변경을 끝내는 아이디어를 좋아한다면, 왜 법이 없는 것일까요?

segments.src: Several obstacles stand in the way.
segments.tr: 몇 가지 장애물이 가로막고 있습니다.

segments.src: 1. **A split over which time.** Ending the switch is popular, but people who want permanent daylight time and people who want permanent standard time often oppose each other more than they oppose the status quo. A bill that satisfies one camp can lose the other.
segments.tr: 1. **어떤 시간을 선택할지에 대한 분열.** 시간 변경을 끝내는 것은 인기가 있지만, 영구적인 일광 절약 시간제를 원하는 사람들과 영구적인 표준시를 원하는 사람들은 종종 현상 유지를 반대하는 것보다 서로를 더 반대합니다. 한쪽 진영을 만족시키는 법안은 다른 쪽 진영을 잃을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** A sunrise at 8:30 a.m. is a minor matter in one part of a time zone and a serious one in another. Lawmakers from northern and western areas of a zone often have different priorities from those in the east.
segments.tr: 2. **지역적 차이.** 오전 8시 30분의 일출은 시간대의 한 지역에서는 사소한 문제이지만 다른 지역에서는 심각한 문제입니다. 시간대의 북쪽과 서쪽 지역의 의원들은 종종 동쪽 지역의 의원들과 다른 우선순위를 가집니다.

segments.src: 3. **Competing priorities.** Time policy rarely ranks above budgets, security and health care on a crowded legislative calendar. Committee leaders may see it as a low-urgency item with high potential for backlash.
segments.tr: 3. **경쟁하는 우선순위.** 시간 정책은 빡빡한 입법 일정에서 예산, 안보, 의료보다 우선순위가 높은 경우가 거의 없습니다. 위원회 지도자들은 이를 반발 가능성이 높은 긴급도가 낮은 안건으로 볼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Industry and regional concerns.** Transportation, broadcasting, agriculture and finance all depend on time standards. Some businesses worry about misalignment with neighboring states or trading partners if states choose different paths.
segments.tr: 4. **산업 및 지역적 우려.** 운송, 방송, 농업 및 금융은 모두 시간 표준에 의존합니다. 일부 기업은 주마다 다른 경로를 선택할 경우 인접 주나 무역 파트너와의 불일치를 우려합니다.

segments.src: 5. **Fear of repeating 1974.** Lawmakers remember that a popular change was reversed once voters felt the effects.
segments.tr: 5. **1974년 반복에 대한 두려움.** 의원들은 유권자들이 그 영향을 체감하자마자 인기 있던 변화가 뒤집혔던 것을 기억합니다.

segments.src: ## The Statehouse Picture
segments.tr: ## 주의회의 상황

segments.src: States keep acting even though they cannot finish the job.
segments.tr: 주들은 일을 끝낼 수 없음에도 불구하고 계속해서 행동을 취하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Some legislatures have passed daylight-time trigger laws.
segments.tr: 일부 주의회는 일광 절약 시간제 트리거 법안을 통과시켰습니다.

segments.src: Others have considered bills for permanent standard time, which they are already allowed to adopt.
segments.tr: 다른 주들은 이미 채택이 허용된 영구 표준시 법안을 고려했습니다.

segments.src: A few have proposed regional compacts so that neighboring states move together.
segments.tr: 일부 주에서는 인접 주들이 함께 움직일 수 있도록 지역 협약을 제안했습니다.

segments.src: Each approach has trade-offs, and none solves the national question alone.
segments.tr: 각 접근 방식에는 장단점이 있으며, 어느 것도 국가적인 문제를 단독으로 해결하지 못합니다.

segments.src: ## What Could Break the Logjam
segments.tr: ## 무엇이 교착 상태를 깰 수 있을까

segments.src: Possible paths include:
segments.tr: 가능한 경로에는 다음이 포함됩니다:

segments.src: - **A compromise bill** that lets each state choose between permanent standard and permanent daylight time, with rules to limit confusion at borders.
segments.tr: - **타협안.** 각 주가 영구 표준시와 영구 일광 절약 시간제 중 하나를 선택할 수 있도록 하되, 경계 지역에서의 혼란을 제한하는 규칙을 포함하는 법안.

segments.src: - **A federal study** that gathers current evidence on health, safety and economic effects before Congress commits.
segments.tr: - **연방 연구.** 의회가 결정하기 전에 건강, 안전 및 경제적 영향에 대한 최신 증거를 수집하는 연구.

segments.src: - **Movement on standard time first**, since states can already adopt it without federal approval, which could build experience and data.
segments.tr: - **표준시로의 우선 전환.** 주들은 이미 연방 승인 없이 이를 채택할 수 있으므로, 이를 통해 경험과 데이터를 구축할 수 있음.

segments.src: Any of these would require sustained attention from leaders who have so far treated the issue as a seasonal curiosity.
segments.tr: 이 중 어떤 것이든 지금까지 이 문제를 계절적인 호기심 정도로 취급해 온 지도자들의 지속적인 관심이 필요할 것입니다.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The clock-change debate persists because it combines wide public frustration with a real scientific and political disagreement.
segments.tr: 시간 변경 논쟁이 지속되는 이유는 광범위한 대중의 좌절감과 실제적인 과학적, 정치적 의견 불일치가 결합되어 있기 때문입니다.

segments.src: Ending the switch is easy to endorse.
segments.tr: 시간 변경을 끝내는 것은 지지하기 쉽습니다.

segments.src: Deciding which permanent time to choose, and who bears the cost of dark mornings or early sunsets, is much harder.
segments.tr: 어떤 영구적인 시간을 선택할지, 그리고 어두운 아침이나 이른 일몰의 비용을 누가 부담할지 결정하는 것은 훨씬 더 어렵습니다.

segments.src: Until lawmakers settle that question, Americans can expect to keep adjusting their clocks twice a year, and to have this argument again each spring and fall.
segments.tr: 의원들이 그 문제를 해결할 때까지 미국인들은 일 년에 두 번씩 시계를 조정해야 하며, 매년 봄과 가을마다 이 논쟁을 다시 겪게 될 것입니다.

segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 위한 것이며 의학적 또는 법적 조언을 구성하지 않습니다.*

segments.tr: El episodio de 2022 se cita a menudo como prueba de lo popular que es la idea.

segments.src: It also showed how little consensus lay beneath the surface.
segments.tr: Tambien mostro cuan poco consenso habia bajo la superficie.

segments.src: Several senators later said they had not examined the details, and some critics argued the chamber had acted without a serious look at the evidence.
segments.tr: Varios senadores dijeron mas tarde que no habian examinado los detalles, y algunos criticos argumentaron que la camara habia actuado sin una mirada seria a la evidencia.

segments.src: ## The Case for Permanent Daylight Time
segments.tr: ## El Argumento a Favor del Horario de Verano Permanente

segments.src: Supporters of year-round daylight time point to several benefits:
segments.tr: Los partidarios del horario de verano durante todo el ano senalan varios beneficios:

segments.src: - **Evening light.** Later sunsets year-round mean more daylight after work and school, which supporters say encourages outdoor activity, shopping and recreation.
segments.tr: - **Luz por la tarde.** Unas puestas de sol mas tardias durante todo el ano significan mas luz natural despues del trabajo y la escuela, lo que segun los defensores fomenta la actividad al aire libre, las compras y la recreacion.

segments.src: - **Safety.** Some studies suggest that more evening light can reduce certain crimes and may lower the risk of pedestrian crashes during the evening commute, when traffic is heavy.
segments.tr: - **Seguridad.** Algunos estudios sugieren que mas luz por la tarde puede reducir ciertos delitos y puede disminuir el riesgo de accidentes de peatones durante el trayecto vespertino, cuando el trafico es pesado.

segments.src: - **Economic activity.** Retail, restaurant and tourism groups have long backed extra daylight hours, arguing that consumers spend more when it is light out.
segments.tr: - **Actividad economica.** Los grupos de comercio minorista, restaurantes y turismo han respaldado durante mucho tiempo las horas adicionales de luz, argumentando que los consumidores gastan mas cuando hay luz.

segments.src: - **No more switching.** Ending the twice-yearly change removes the disruption it causes, including a short-term rise in some health and safety problems around the spring shift.
segments.tr: - **No mas cambios.** Terminar con el cambio bianual elimina la perturbacion que causa, incluido un aumento a corto plazo en algunos problemas de salud y seguridad alrededor del cambio de primavera.

segments.src: ## The Case for Permanent Standard Time
segments.tr: ## El Argumento a Favor del Horario Estandar Permanente

segments.src: Many sleep scientists and medical groups favor the opposite approach.
segments.tr: Muchos expertos en sueno y grupos medicos prefieren el enfoque opuesto.

segments.src: The American Academy of Sleep Medicine and other professional bodies have said that permanent standard time better matches the human body clock, because it aligns more closely with the natural cycle of sunrise and sunset.
segments.tr: La Academia Estadounidense de Medicina del Sueno y otros organos profesionales han dicho que el horario estandar permanente se adapta mejor al reloj biologico humano, porque se alinea mas estrechamente con el ciclo natural del amanecer y el atardecer.

segments.src: Their main points are:
segments.tr: Sus puntos principales son:

segments.src: - **Circadian health.** Standard time puts more light in the morning, which helps regulate sleep and alertness. Permanent daylight time would mean very late sunrises in winter, especially in the western parts of time zones. In some places the sun would not rise until well after 8 a.m.
segments.tr: - **Salud circadiana.** El horario estandar pone mas luz por la manana, lo que ayuda a regular el sueno y el estado de alerta. El horario de verano permanente significaria amaneceres muy tardios en invierno, especialmente en las partes occidentales de las zonas horarias. En algunos lugares el sol no saldria hasta bien pasadas las 8 a.m.

segments.src: - **Sleep and long-term health.** Researchers have linked chronic misalignment between social clocks and the body clock with sleep loss and other health problems. Advocates say standard time is the safer bet.
segments.tr: - **Sueno y salud a largo plazo.** Los investigadores han vinculado la desalineacion cronica entre los relojes sociales y el reloj biologico con la perdida de sueno y otros problemas de salud. Los defensores dicen que el horario estandar es la apuesta mas segura.

segments.src: - **School mornings.** Children would commonly wait for buses and walk to school in the dark during winter months under permanent daylight time.
segments.tr: - **Muganas escolares.** Los ninos comunmente esperarian los autobuses y caminarian a la escuela en la oscuridad durante los meses de invierno bajo el horario de verano permanente.

segments.src: Evidence on both sides is real but imperfect.
segments.tr: La evidencia en ambos lados es real pero imperfecta.

segments.src: Studies vary in method and in geography, and a benefit in one region can be a cost in another.
segments.tr: Los estudios varian en metodo y en geografia, y un beneficio en una region puede ser un costo en otra.

segments.src: ## Lessons From the Past
segments.tr: ## Lecciones del Pasado

segments.src: The United States has tried this before.
segments.tr: Estados Unidos ya ha intentado esto antes.

segments.src: In 1974, Congress enacted year-round daylight time as a response to the energy crisis.
segments.tr: En 1974, el Congreso promulgo el horario de verano durante todo el ano como respuesta a la crisis energetica.

segments.src: Early public support faded within months as winter mornings stayed dark, and Congress reversed course the following year.
segments.tr: El apoyo publico inicial se desvanecio en pocos meses a medida que las mananas de invierno permanecian oscuras, y el Congreso cambio de rumbo al ano siguiente.

segments.src: Supporters of permanence say today's circumstances are different.
segments.tr: Los partidarios de la permanencia dicen que las circunstancias actuales son diferentes.

segments.src: Critics say the episode is a warning.
segments.tr: Los criticos dicen que el episodio es una advertencia.

segments.src: ## Why Nothing Gets Done
segments.tr: ## Por Que No Se Hace Nada

segments.src: If both parties like the idea of ending clock changes, why is there no law?
segments.tr: Si a ambos partidos les gusta la idea de terminar con el cambio de hora, por que no hay ley?

segments.src: Several obstacles stand in the way.
segments.tr: Varios obstaculos se interponen en el camino.

segments.src: 1. **A split over which time.** Ending the switch is popular, but people who want permanent daylight time and people who want permanent standard time often oppose each other more than they oppose the status quo. A bill that satisfies one camp can lose the other.
segments.tr: 1. **Una division sobre que hora.** Terminar con el cambio es popular, pero las personas que quieren un horario de verano permanente y las personas que quieren un horario estandar permanente a menudo se oponen entre si mas de lo que se oponen al statu quo. Un proyecto de ley que satisface a un bando puede perder al otro.

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** A sunrise at 8:30 a.m. is a minor matter in one part of a time zone and a serious one in another. Lawmakers from northern and western areas of a zone often have different priorities from those in the east.
segments.tr: 2. **Diferencias regionales.** Un amanecer a las 8:30 a.m. es un asunto menor en una parte de una zona horaria y uno grave en otra. Los legisladores de las areas del norte y oeste de una zona a menudo tienen prioridades diferentes a las del este.

segments.src: 3. **Competing priorities.** Time policy rarely ranks above budgets, security and health care on a crowded legislative calendar. Committee leaders may see it as a low-urgency item with high potential for backlash.
segments.tr: 3. **Prioridades competidas.** La politica horaria rara vez se ubica por encima de los presupuestos, la seguridad y la atencion medica en un calendario legislativo abarrotado. Los lideres de los comites pueden verlo como un articulo de baja urgencia con un alto potencial de reacciones negativas.

segments.src: 4. **Industry and regional concerns.** Transportation, broadcasting, agriculture and finance all depend on time standards. Some businesses worry about misalignment with neighboring states or trading partners if states choose different paths.
segments.tr: 4. **Preocupaciones industriales y regionales.** El transporte, la radiodifusion, la agricultura y las finanzas dependen de los estandares de tiempo. Algunas empresas se preocupan por la desalineacion con los estados vecinos o socios comerciales si los estados eligen caminos diferentes.

segments.src: 5. **Fear of repeating 1974.** Lawmakers remember that a popular change was reversed once voters felt the effects.
segments.tr: 5. **Miedo a repetir 1974.** Los legisladores recuerdan que un cambio popular se revirtio una vez que los votantes sintieron los efectos.

segments.src: ## The Statehouse Picture
segments.tr: ## El Panorama de las Sedes Estatales

segments.src: States keep acting even though they cannot finish the job.
segments.tr: Los estados siguen actuando a pesar de que no pueden terminar el trabajo.

segments.src: Some legislatures have passed daylight-time trigger laws.
segments.tr: Algunas legislaturas han aprobado leyes de activacion del horario de verano.

segments.src: Others have considered bills for permanent standard time, which they are already allowed to adopt.
segments.tr: Otras han considerado proyectos de ley para el horario estandar permanente, que ya se les permite adoptar.

segments.src: A few have proposed regional compacts so that neighboring states move together.
segments.tr: Algunas han propuesto pactos regionales para que los estados vecinos se muevan juntos.

segments.src: Each approach has trade-offs, and none solves the national question alone.
segments.tr: Cada enfoque tiene contrapartidas, y ninguno resuelve la pregunta nacional por si solo.

segments.src: ## What Could Break the Logjam
segments.tr: ## Que Podria Romper el Bloqueo

segments.src: Possible paths include:
segments.tr: Los caminos posibles incluyen:

segments.src: - **A compromise bill** that lets each state choose between permanent standard and permanent daylight time, with rules to limit confusion at borders.
segments.tr: - **Un proyecto de ley de compromiso** que permita a cada estado elegir entre el horario estandar y el de verano permanente, con reglas para limitar la confusion en las fronteras.

segments.src: - **A federal study** that gathers current evidence on health, safety and economic effects before Congress commits.
segments.tr: - **Un estudio federal** que reuna la evidencia actual sobre salud, seguridad y efectos economicos antes de que el Congreso se comprometa.

segments.src: - **Movement on standard time first**, since states can already adopt it without federal approval, which could build experience and data.
segments.tr: - **Movimiento en el horario estandar primero**, ya que los estados ya pueden adoptarlo sin aprobacion federal, lo que podria construir experiencia y datos.

segments.src: Any of these would require sustained attention from leaders who have so far treated the issue as a seasonal curiosity.
segments.tr: Cualquiera de estos requeriria la atencion sostenida de los lideres que hasta ahora han tratado el tema como una curiosidad estacional.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## El Resultado Final

segments.src: The clock-change debate persists because it combines wide public frustration with a real scientific and political disagreement.
segments.tr: El debate sobre el cambio de hora persiste porque combina una amplia frustracion publica con un desacuerdo cientifico y politico real.

segments.src: Ending the switch is easy to endorse.
segments.tr: Terminar con el cambio es facil de respaldar.

segments.src: Deciding which permanent time to choose, and who bears the cost of dark mornings or early sunsets, is much harder.
segments.tr: Decidir que hora permanente elegir, y quien soporta el costo de las mananas oscuras o las puestas de sol tempranas, es mucho mas dificil.

segments.src: Until lawmakers settle that question, Americans can expect to keep adjusting their clocks twice a year, and to have this argument again each spring and fall.
segments.tr: Hasta que los legisladores resuelvan esa pregunta, los estadounidenses pueden esperar seguir ajustando sus relojes dos veces al ano, y tener esta discusion nuevamente cada primavera y otono.

segments.tr: *Este articulo es para informacion general y no constituye consejo medico o legal.*

ar.title: العودة إلى الوراء مرة أخرى: لماذا لا تزال مناقشة التوقيت الصيفي الدائم تراوح مكانها؟

segments.src: Every autumn, Americans gain an hour of sleep and lose an hour of evening light.
segments.tr: في كل خريف، يكتسب الأمريكيون ساعة إضافية من النوم ويفقدون ساعة من ضوء المساء.

segments.src: With clocks having just turned back for the year, a familiar question returns: why are we still doing this twice a year?
segments.tr: مع رجوع الساعات للتو لهذا العام، يعود سؤال مألوف: لماذا ما زلنا نقوم بذلك مرتين في السنة؟

segments.src: Polls regularly show that many Americans would like to stop changing the clocks.
segments.tr: تُظهر استطلاعات الرأي بانتظام أن العديد من الأمريكيين يرغبون في التوقف عن تغيير الساعات.

segments.src: Yet years of bills, hearings and statehouse debates have produced no national change.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، فإن سنوات من مشاريع القوانين، وجلسات الاستماع، ونقاشات المجالس التشريعية لم تفضِ إلى أي تغيير وطني.

segments.src: The reason has less to do with indifference than with a disagreement over which time to keep.
segments.tr: السبب يتعلق باللامبالاة بشكل أقل مقارنة بالخلاف حول أي توقيت يجب اعتماده.

segments.src: ## Where the Law Stands
segments.tr: ## وضع القانون

segments.src: Under the Uniform Time Act of 1966, states may opt out of daylight saving time and stay on standard time all year.
segments.tr: بموجب قانون التوقيت الموحد لعام 1966، يجوز للstates (الولايات) الانسحاب من التوقيت الصيفي والبقاء على التوقيت القياسي طوال العام.

segments.src: Arizona (apart from the Navajo Nation) and Hawaii have done so.
segments.tr: لقد قامت أريزونا (بغض النظر عن أمة نافاهو) وهاواي بذلك.

segments.src: States cannot, however, adopt permanent daylight saving time on their own.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، لا يمكن للولايات اعتماد التوقيت الصيفي الدائم بمفردها.

segments.src: That change requires an act of Congress.
segments.tr: هذا التغيير يتطلب قانوناً يصدره الكونغرس.

segments.src: Dozens of states have passed laws or resolutions that would move to year-round daylight time if Congress allowed it.
segments.tr: أقرت عشرات الولايات قوانين أو قرارات من شأنها الانتقال إلى التوقيت الصيفي على مدار العام إذا سمح الكونغرس بذلك.

segments.src: These measures are often called "trigger" laws because they take effect only after federal permission.
segments.tr: غالبًا ما تُسمى هذه التدابير بقوانين "الزناد" لأنها لا تدخل حيز التنفيذ إلا بعد الحصول على إذن فدرالي.

segments.src: This leaves a patchwork of intentions with no clear path forward.
segments.tr: وهذا يترك خليطًا من النوايا دون مسار واضح للمضي قدمًا.

segments.src: ## The Bill That Almost Was
segments.tr: ## مشروع القانون الذي كاد أن يصبح حقيقة

segments.src: The best-known attempt was the Sunshine Protection Act.
segments.tr: كانت المحاولة الأكثر شهرة هي قانون حماية أشعة الشمس.

segments.src: In March 2022 the Senate passed it by unanimous consent, with little debate.
segments.tr: في مارس 2022، أقره مجلس الشيوخ بالإجماع، وسط نقاش ضئيل.

segments.src: The bill would have made daylight saving time permanent nationwide.
segments.tr: كان من شأن مشروع القانون أن يجعل التوقيت الصيفي دائمًا على مستوى الدولة بأكملها.

segments.src: The House did not take it up, and the bill expired at the end of that session.
segments.tr: لم يناقشه مجلس النواب، وانتهت صلاحية مشروع القانون في نهاية تلك الدورة.

segments.src: Versions have been reintroduced in later Congresses with bipartisan sponsors, and they have again stalled in committee.
segments.tr: تم إعادة تقديم نسخ منه في دورات لاحقة للكونغرس بدعم من الحزبين، وتأجلت مرة أخرى في اللجان.

segments.src: The 2022 episode is often cited as proof of how popular the idea is.
segments.tr: غالبًا ما يُستشهد بحادثة عام 2022 كدليل على مدى شعبية هذه الفكرة.

segments.src: It also showed how little consensus lay beneath the surface.
segments.tr: كما أظهرت مدى ضآلة الإجماع الكامن تحت السطح.

segments.src: Several senators later said they had not examined the details, and some critics argued the chamber had acted without a serious look at the evidence.
segments.tr: قال العديد من أعضاء مجلس الشيوخ لاحقًا إنهم لم يفحصوا التفاصيل، وجادل بعض النقاد بأن المجلس تصرف دون نظرة جادة للأدلة.

segments.src: ## The Case for Permanent Daylight Time
segments.tr: ## حجج التوقيت الصيفي الدائم

segments.src: Supporters of year-round daylight time point to several benefits:
segments.tr: يشير مؤيدو التوقيت الصيفي على مدار العام إلى عدة فوائد:

segments.src: - **Evening light.** Later sunsets year-round mean more daylight after work and school, which supporters say encourages outdoor activity, shopping and recreation.
segments.tr: - **ضوء المساء.** تعني غروب الشمس المتأخر طوال العام مزيدًا من ضوء النهار بعد العمل والمدرسة، وهو ما يقول المؤيدون إنه يشجع على الأنشطة الخارجية والتسوق والترفيه.

segments.src: - **Safety.** Some studies suggest that more evening light can reduce certain crimes and may lower the risk of pedestrian crashes during the evening commute, when traffic is heavy.
segments.tr: - **السلامة.** تشير بعض الدراسات إلى أن المزيد من ضوء المساء يمكن أن يقلل من بعض الجرائم وقد يخفض مخاطر حوادث المشاة أثناء التنقل المسائي عندما تكون حركة المرور كثيفة.

segments.src: - **Economic activity.** Retail, restaurant and tourism groups have long backed extra daylight hours, arguing that consumers spend more when it is light out.
segments.tr: - **النشاط الاقتصادي.** دَعمت مجموعات التجارة بالتجزئة والمطاعم والسياحة منذ فترة طويلة ساعات النهار الإضافية، محتجة بأن المستهلكين ينفقون أكثر عندما يكون الجو مضاءً.

segments.src: - **No more switching.** Ending the twice-yearly change removes the disruption it causes, including a short-term rise in some health and safety problems around the spring shift.
segments.tr: - **لا مزيد من التبديل.** إنهاء التغيير مرتين في السنة يزيل الاضطراب الذي يسببه، بما في ذلك ارتفاع قصير الأجل في بعض مشاكل الصحة والسلامة حول تحول الربيع.

segments.src: ## The Case for Permanent Standard Time
segments.tr: ## حجج التوقيت القياسي الدائم

segments.src: Many sleep scientists and medical groups favor the opposite approach.
segments.tr: يفضل العديد من علماء النوم والمجموعات الطبية النهج المعاكس.

segments.src: The American Academy of Sleep Medicine and other professional bodies have said that permanent standard time better matches the human body clock, because it aligns more closely with the natural cycle of sunrise and sunset.
segments.tr: قالت الأكاديمية الأمريكية طب النوم وغيرها من الهيئات المهنية إن التوقيت القياسي الدائم يتوافق بشكل أفضل مع ساعة جسم الإنسان، لأنه يتماشى بشكل أقرب مع الدورة الطبيعية للشروق والغروب.

segments.src: Their main points are:
segments.tr: نقاطهم الرئيسية هي:

segments.src: - **Circadian health.** Standard time puts more light in the morning, which helps regulate sleep and alertness. Permanent daylight time would mean very late sunrises in winter, especially in the western parts of time zones. In some places the sun would not rise until well after 8 a.m.
segments.tr: - **صحة الساعة البيولوجية.** يضع التوقيت القياسي مزيدًا من الضوء في الصباح، مما يساعد على تنظيم النوم اليقظة. التوقيت الصيفي الدائم سيعني شروق شمس متأخر جدًا في الشتاء، خاصة في الأجزاء الغربية من المناطق الزمنية. في بعض الأام لن تشرق الشمس إلا بعد الساعة 8 صباحًا بكثير.

segments.src: - **Sleep and long-term health.** Researchers have linked chronic misalignment between social clocks and the body clock with sleep loss and other health problems. Advocates say standard time is the safer bet.
segments.tr: - **النوم والصحة طويلة الأجل.** ربط الباحثون بين عدم التوافق المزمن بين الساعات الاجتماعية وساعة الجسم وفقدان النوم ومشاكل صحية أخرى. يقول المدافعون إن التوقيت القياسي هو الرهان الأكثر أمانًا.

segments.src: - **School mornings.** Children would commonly wait for buses and walk to school in the dark during winter months under permanent daylight time.
segments.tr: - **صباح المدرسة.** عادة ما ينتظر الأطفال الحافلات ويسيرون إلى المدرسة في الظلام خلال أشهر الشتاء في ظل التوقيت الصيفي الدائم.

segments.src: Evidence on both sides is real but imperfect.
segments.tr: الأدلة على كلا الجانبين حقيقية ولكنها غير مكتملة.

segments.src: Studies vary in method and in geography, and a benefit in one region can be a cost in another.
segments.tr: تختلف الدراسات في المنهجية والجغرافيا، وفائدة في منطقة ما قد تكون تكلفة في منطقة أخرى.

segments.src: ## Lessons From the Past
segments.tr: ## دروس من الماضي

segments.src: The United States has tried this before.
segments.tr: جربت الولايات المتحدة هذا من قبل.

segments.src: In 1974, Congress enacted year-round daylight time as a response to the energy crisis.
segments.tr: في عام 1974، سنَّ الكونغرس التوقيت الصيفي على مدار العام استجابة لأزمة الطاقة.

segments.src: Early public support faded within months as winter mornings stayed dark, and Congress reversed course the following year.
segments.tr: تلاشت الدعم العام المبكر في غضون أشهر حيث ظل صباح الشتاء مظلمًا، وعكس الكونغرس مساره في العام التالي.

segments.src: Supporters of permanence say today's circumstances are different.
segments.tr: يقول مؤيدو الدوام إن ظروف اليوم مختلفة.

segments.src: Critics say the episode is a warning.
segments.tr: يقول النقاد إن هذه الحلقة تحذير.

segments.src: ## Why Nothing Gets Done
segments.tr: ## لماذا لا يتم إنجاز شيء

segments.src: If both parties like the idea of ending clock changes, why is there no law?
segments.tr: إذا كان كلا الحزبين يحبان فكرة إنهاء تغيير الساعات، فلماذا لا يوجد قانون؟

segments.src: Several obstacles stand in the way.
segments.tr: تقف عدة عقبات في طريق ذلك.

segments.src: 1. **A split over which time.** Ending the switch is popular, but people who want permanent daylight time and people who want permanent standard time often oppose each other more than they oppose the status quo. A bill that satisfies one camp can lose the other.
segments.tr: 1. **انقسام حول أي توقيت.** إنهاء التبديل أمر شائر، لكن الأشخاص الذين يريدون التوقيت الصيفي الدائم والأشخاص الذين يريدون التوقيت القياسي الدائم غالباً ما يعارضون بعضهم البعض أكثر مما يعارضون الوضع الراهن. مشروع قانون يرضي معسكراً قد يخسر المعسكر الآخر.

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** A sunrise at 8:30 a.m. is a minor matter in one part of a time zone and a serious one in another. Lawmakers from northern and western areas of a zone often have different priorities from those in the east.
segments.tr: 2. **الفروق الإقليمية.** شروق الشمس في الساعة 8:30 صباحًا هو مسألة بسيطة في جزء من المنطقة الزمنية ومسألة خطيرة في جزء آخر. غالباً ما يكون لدى المشرعين من المناطق الشمالية والغربية من المنطقة أولويات مختلفة عن أولئك في الشرق.

segments.src: 3. **Competing priorities.** Time policy rarely ranks above budgets, security and health care on a crowded legislative calendar. Committee leaders may see it as a low-urgency item with high potential for backlash.
segments.tr: 3. **الأولويات المتنافسة.** نادراً ما يحتل سياسات الوقت مرتبة أعلى من الميزانيات والأمن والرعاية الصحية على جدول أعمال تشريعي مزدحم. قد يرى قادة اللجان أنه عنصر منخفض الأهمية مع احتمال كبير ل ردود فعل عكسية.

segments.src: 4. **Industry and regional concerns.** Transportation, broadcasting, agriculture and finance all depend on time standards. Some businesses worry about misalignment with neighboring states or trading partners if states choose different paths.

segments.src: 5. **Fear of repeating 1974.** Lawmakers remember that a popular change was reversed once voters felt the effects.
segments.tr: 5. **الخوف من تكرار عام 1974.** يتذكر المشرعون أن التغيير الشعبي تم عكسه بمجرد أن شعر الناخبون بالتأثيرات.

segments.src: ## The Statehouse Picture
segments.tr: ## صورة البرلمانات الولائية

segments.src: States keep acting even though they cannot finish the job.

segments.src: Some legislatures have passed daylight-time trigger laws.
segments.tr: أقرت بعض المجالس التشريعية قوانين زناد التوقيت الصيفي.

segments.src: Others have considered bills for permanent standard time, which they are already allowed to adopt.
segments.tr: نظر آخرون في مشاريع قوانين للتوقيت القياسي الدائم، والتي سُمح لهم بالفعل باعتمادها.

segments.src: A few have proposed regional compacts so that neighboring states move together.

segments.src: Each approach has trade-offs, and none solves the national question alone.

segments.src: ## What Could Break the Logjam
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يمكن أن يكسر الجمود

segments.src: Possible paths include:
segments.tr: تشمل المسارات المحتملة:

segments.src: - **A compromise bill** that lets each state choose between permanent standard and permanent daylight time, with rules to limit confusion at borders.
segments.tr: - **مشروع قانون تسوية** يسمح لكل ولاية بالاختيار بين التوقيت القياسي الدائم والتوقيت الصيفي الدائم، مع قواعد للحد من الارتباك على الحدود.

segments.src: - **A federal study** that gathers current evidence on health, safety and economic effects before Congress commits.
segments.tr: - **دراسة اتحادية** تجمع الأدلة الحالية حول الآثار الصحية والسلامة والاقتصادية قبل أن يلتزم الكونغرس.

segments.src: - **Movement on standard time first**, since states can already adopt it without federal approval, which could build experience and data.
segments.tr: - **التحرك نحو التوقيت القياسي أولاً**، نظراً لأن الولايات يمكنها بالفعل اعتماده دون موافقة اتحادية، مما قد يبني خبرة وبيانات.

segments.src: Any of these would require sustained attention from leaders who have so far treated the issue as a seasonal curiosity.
segments.tr: أي من هذه سيتطلب اهتماماً مستمراً من القادة الذين عاطوا القضية حتى الآن كفضول موسمي.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The clock-change debate persists because it combines wide public frustration with a real scientific and political disagreement.
segments.tr: تستمر مناقشة تغيير الساعات لأنها تجمع بين الإحباط العام الواسع وخلاف علمي وسياسي حقيقي.

segments.tr: تحديد أي توقيت دائم يجب اختياره، ومن يتحمل تكلفة صباحات مظلمة أو غروب شمس مبكر، هو أمر أصعب بكثير.

segments.src: Until lawmakers settle that question, Americans can expect to keep adjusting their clocks twice a year, and to have this argument again each spring and fall.

fr.title: Reculer l'heure, encore une fois : pourquoi le débat sur l'heure d'été permanente n'aboutit toujours pas

segments.src: Every autumn, Americans gain an hour of sleep and lose an hour of evening light.
segments.tr: Chaque automne, les Américains gagnent une heure de sommeil et perdent une heure de lumière en soirée.

segments.src: With clocks having just turned back for the year, a familiar question returns: why are we still doing this twice a year?
segments.tr: Alors que les horloges viennent de reculer pour l'année, une question familière revient : pourquoi continuons-nous à faire cela deux fois par an ?

segments.src: Polls regularly show that many Americans would like to stop changing the clocks.
segments.tr: Les sondages montrent régulièrement que de nombreux Américains aimeraient cesser de changer d'heure.

segments.src: Yet years of bills, hearings and statehouse debates have produced no national change.
segments.tr: Pourtant, des années de projets de loi, d'auditions et de débats parlementaires n'ont entraîné aucun changement à l'échelle nationale.

segments.src: The reason has less to do with indifference than with a disagreement over which time to keep.
segments.tr: La raison tient moins à l'indifférence qu'à un désaccord sur l'heure qu'il convient de conserver.

segments.src: ## Where the Law Stands
segments.tr: ## Où en est la loi

segments.src: Under the Uniform Time Act of 1966, states may opt out of daylight saving time and stay on standard time all year.
segments.tr: En vertu du Uniform Time Act de 1966, les États peuvent refuser l'heure d'été et rester à l'heure standard toute l'année.

segments.src: Arizona (apart from the Navajo Nation) and Hawaii have done so.
segments.tr: L'Arizona (à l'exception de la Nation Navajo) et Hawaï l'ont fait.

segments.src: States cannot, however, adopt permanent daylight saving time on their own.
segments.tr: Les États ne peuvent cependant pas adopter l'heure d'été permanente de leur propre chef.

segments.src: That change requires an act of Congress.
segments.tr: Ce changement nécessite une loi du Congrès.

segments.src: Dozens of states have passed laws or resolutions that would move to year-round daylight time if Congress allowed it.
segments.tr: Des dizaines d'États ont adopté des lois ou des résolutions qui permettraient de passer à l'heure d'été toute l'année si le Congrès le permettait.

segments.src: These measures are often called "trigger" laws because they take effect only after federal permission.
segments.tr: Ces mesures sont souvent appelées lois « déclencheuses » (trigger laws) car elles ne prennent effet qu'après l'autorisation fédérale.

segments.src: This leaves a patchwork of intentions with no clear path forward.
segments.tr: Cela laisse un patchwork d'intentions sans voie claire vers l'avant.

segments.src: ## The Bill That Almost Was
segments.tr: ## Le projet de loi qui a failli aboutir

segments.src: The best-known attempt was the Sunshine Protection Act.
segments.tr: La tentative la plus connue a été le Sunshine Protection Act.

segments.src: In March 2022 the Senate passed it by unanimous consent, with little debate.
segments.tr: En mars 2022, le Sénat l'a adopté à l'unanimité, sans grand débat.

segments.src: The bill would have made daylight saving time permanent nationwide.
segments.tr: Le projet de loi aurait rendu l'heure d'été permanente dans tout le pays.

segments.src: The House did not take it up, and the bill expired at the end of that session.
segments.tr: La Chambre des représentants ne s'en est pas saisie, et le projet de loi a expiré à la fin de cette session.

segments.src: Versions have been reintroduced in later Congresses with bipartisan sponsors, and they have again stalled in committee.
segments.tr: Des versions ont été réintroduites dans des Congrès ultérieurs avec des parrains bipartites, et elles ont à nouveau stagne en commission.

segments.src: The 2022 episode is often cited as proof of how popular the idea is.
segments.tr: L'épisode de 2022 est souvent cité comme la preuve de la popularité de l'idée.

segments.src: It also showed how little consensus lay beneath the surface.
segments.tr: Il a également montré à quel point le consensus était faible sous la surface.

segments.src: Several senators later said they had not examined the details, and some critics argued the chamber had acted without a serious look at the evidence.
segments.tr: Plusieurs sénateurs ont déclaré plus tard qu'ils n'avaient pas examiné les détails, et certains critiques ont soutenu que la chambre avait agi sans examen sérieux des preuves.

segments.src: ## The Case for Permanent Daylight Time
segments.tr: ## Les arguments en faveur de l'heure d'été permanente

segments.src: Supporters of year-round daylight time point to several benefits:
segments.tr: Les partisans de l'heure d'été toute l'année mettent en avant plusieurs avantages :

segments.src: - **Evening light.** Later sunsets year-round mean more daylight after work and school, which supporters say encourages outdoor activity, shopping and recreation.
segments.tr: - **Lumière du soir.** Des couchers de soleil plus tardifs toute l'année signifient plus de lumière du jour après le travail et l'école, ce qui encourage les activités en plein air, le shopping et les loisirs selon ses partisans.

segments.src: - **Safety.** Some studies suggest that more evening light can reduce certain crimes and may lower the risk of pedestrian crashes during the evening commute, when traffic is heavy.
segments.tr: - **Sécurité.** Certaines études suggèrent que davantage de lumière en soirée peut réduire certains crimes et diminuer le risque d'accidents de piétons pendant le trajet du soir, lorsque le trafic est dense.

segments.src: - **Economic activity.** Retail, restaurant and tourism groups have long backed extra daylight hours, arguing that consumers spend more when it is light out.
segments.tr: - **Activité économique.** Les secteurs du commerce de détail, de la restauration et du tourisme soutiennent depuis longtemps les heures de lumière supplémentaires, affirmant que les consommateurs dépensent plus lorsqu'il fait jour.

segments.src: - **No more switching.** Ending the twice-yearly change removes the disruption it causes, including a short-term rise in some health and safety problems around the spring shift.
segments.tr: - **Fini les changements d'heure.** Mettre fin au changement semestriel élimine les perturbations qu'il entraîne, notamment une hausse à court terme de certains problèmes de santé et de sécurité autour du passage à l'heure d'été au printemps.

segments.src: ## The Case for Permanent Standard Time
segments.tr: ## Les arguments en faveur de l'heure standard permanente

segments.src: Many sleep scientists and medical groups favor the opposite approach.
segments.tr: De nombreux spécialistes du sommeil et groupes médicaux privilégient l'approche inverse.

segments.src: The American Academy of Sleep Medicine and other professional bodies have said that permanent standard time better matches the human body clock, because it aligns more closely with the natural cycle of sunrise and sunset.
segments.tr: L'American Academy of Sleep Medicine et d'autres organismes professionnels ont déclaré que l'heure standard permanente correspond mieux à l'horloge biologique humaine, car elle s'aligne plus étroitement sur le cycle naturel du lever et du coucher du soleil.

segments.src: Their main points are:
segments.tr: Leurs points principaux sont :

segments.src: - **Circadian health.** Standard time puts more light in the morning, which helps regulate sleep and alertness. Permanent daylight time would mean very late sunrises in winter, especially in the western parts of time zones. In some places the sun would not rise until well after 8 a.m.
segments.tr: - **Santé circadienne.** L'heure standard apporte plus de lumière le matin, ce qui aide à réguler le sommeil et la vigilance. L'heure d'été permanente signifierait des levers de soleil très tardifs en hiver, en particulier dans les parties occidentales des fuseaux horaires. Dans certains endroits, le soleil ne se lèverait qu'après 8 heures du matin.

segments.src: - **Sleep and long-term health.** Researchers have linked chronic misalignment between social clocks and the body clock with sleep loss and other health problems. Advocates say standard time is the safer bet.
segments.tr: - **Sommeil et santé à long terme.** Des chercheurs ont lié le désalignement chronique entre les horloges sociales et l'horloge biologique au manque de sommeil et à d'autres problèmes de santé. Les défenseurs affirment que l'heure standard est le choix le plus sûr.

segments.src: - **School mornings.** Children would commonly wait for buses and walk to school in the dark during winter months under permanent daylight time.
segments.tr: - **Les matins d'école.** Les enfants attendraient souvent le bus et marcheraient vers l'école dans le noir pendant les mois d'hiver sous l'heure d'été permanente.

segments.src: Evidence on both sides is real but imperfect.
segments.tr: Les preuves des deux côtés sont réelles mais imparfaites.

segments.src: Studies vary in method and in geography, and a benefit in one region can be a cost in another.
segments.tr: Les études varient dans leur méthode et leur géographie, et un avantage dans une région peut être un coût dans une autre.

segments.src: ## Lessons From the Past
segments.tr: ## Les leçons du passé

segments.src: The United States has tried this before.
segments.tr: Les États-Unis ont déjà essayé cela auparavant.

segments.src: In 1974, Congress enacted year-round daylight time as a response to the energy crisis.
segments.tr: En 1974, le Congrès a instauré l'heure d'été toute l'année en réponse à la crise de l'énergie.

segments.src: Early public support faded within months as winter mornings stayed dark, and Congress reversed course the following year.
segments.tr: Le soutien public initial s'est estompé en quelques mois car les matins d'hiver restaient sombres, et le Congrès a fait marche arrière l'année suivante.

segments.src: Supporters of permanence say today's circumstances are different.
segments.tr: Les partisans de la permanence affirment que les circonstances d'aujourd'hui sont différentes.

segments.src: Critics say the episode is a warning.
segments.tr: Les critiques disent que cet épisode sert de mise en garde.

segments.src: ## Why Nothing Gets Done
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi rien ne se fait

segments.src: If both parties like the idea of ending clock changes, why is there no law?
segments.tr: Si les deux partis aiment l'idée de mettre fin aux changements d'heure, pourquoi n'y a-t-il pas de loi ?

segments.src: Several obstacles stand in the way.
segments.tr: Plusieurs obstacles s'y opposent.

segments.src: 1. **A split over which time.** Ending the switch is popular, but people who want permanent daylight time and people who want permanent standard time often oppose each other more than they oppose the status quo. A bill that satisfies one camp can lose the other.
segments.tr: 1. **Une division sur le choix de l'heure.** Mettre fin au changement est populaire, mais les personnes qui veulent l'heure d'été permanente et celles qui veulent l'heure standard permanente s'opposent souvent plus entre elles qu'elles ne s'opposent au statu quo. Un projet de loi qui satisfait un camp peut perdre l'autre.

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** A sunrise at 8:30 a.m. is a minor matter in one part of a time zone and a serious one in another. Lawmakers from northern and western areas of a zone often have different priorities from those in the east.
segments.tr: 2. **Différences régionales.** Un lever de soleil à 8 h 30 est une question mineure dans une partie d'un fuseau horaire et un problème sérieux dans une autre. Les législateurs des zones situées au nord et à l'ouest d'un fuseau ont souvent des priorités différentes de ceux de l'est.

segments.src: 3. **Competing priorities.** Time policy rarely ranks above budgets, security and health care on a crowded legislative calendar. Committee leaders may see it as a low-urgency item with high potential for backlash.
segments.tr: 3. **Priorités concurrentes.** La politique horaire se situe rarement au-dessus des budgets, de la sécurité et des soins de santé dans un calendrier législatif chargé. Les dirigeants de commissions peuvent la considérer comme un sujet peu urgent à fort potentiel de rejet.

segments.src: 4. **Industry and regional concerns.** Transportation, broadcasting, agriculture and finance all depend on time standards. Some businesses worry about misalignment with neighboring states or trading partners if states choose different paths.
segments.tr: 4. **Préoccupations industrielles et régionales.** Les transports, la radiodiffusion, l'agriculture et la finance dépendent tous des normes horaires. Certaines entreprises s'inquiètent d'un désalignement avec les États voisins ou les partenaires commerciaux si les États choisissent des voies différentes.

segments.src: 5. **Fear of repeating 1974.** Lawmakers remember that a popular change was reversed once voters felt the effects.
segments.tr: 5. **La peur de répéter 1974.** Les législateurs se souviennent qu'un changement populaire a été annulé une fois que les électeurs en ont ressenti les effets.

segments.src: ## The Statehouse Picture
segments.tr: ## Le tableau au niveau des États

segments.src: States keep acting even though they cannot finish the job.
segments.tr: Les États continuent d'agir même s'ils ne peuvent pas terminer le travail.

segments.src: Some legislatures have passed daylight-time trigger laws.
segments.tr: Certaines législatures ont adopté des lois déclencheuses pour l'heure d'été.

segments.src: Others have considered bills for permanent standard time, which they are already allowed to adopt.
segments.tr: D'autres ont examiné des projets de loi pour l'heure standard permanente, qu'ils sont déjà autorisés à adopter.

segments.src: A few have proposed regional compacts so that neighboring states move together.
segments.tr: Quelques-uns ont proposé des pactes régionaux afin que les États voisins évoluent ensemble.

segments.src: Each approach has trade-offs, and none solves the national question alone.
segments.tr: Chaque approche présente des compromis, et aucune ne résout seule la question nationale.

segments.src: ## What Could Break the Logjam
segments.tr: ## Ce qui pourrait débloquer la situation

segments.src: Possible paths include:
segments.tr: Les voies possibles incluent :

segments.src: - **A compromise bill** that lets each state choose between permanent standard and permanent daylight time, with rules to limit confusion at borders.
segments.tr: - **Un projet de loi de compromis** qui laisse chaque État choisir entre l'heure standard permanente et l'heure d'été permanente, avec des règles pour limiter la confusion aux frontières.

segments.src: - **A federal study** that gathers current evidence on health, safety and economic effects before Congress commits.
segments.tr: - **Une étude fédérale** rassemblant des preuves actuelles sur la santé, la sécurité et les effets économiques avant que le Congrès ne s'engage.

segments.src: - **Movement on standard time first**, since states can already adopt it without federal approval, which could build experience and data.
segments.tr: - **Un mouvement d'abord sur l'heure standard**, puisque les États peuvent déjà l'adopter sans l'approbation fédérale, ce qui pourrait permettre de cumuler de l'expérience et des données.

segments.src: Any of these would require sustained attention from leaders who have so far treated the issue as a seasonal curiosity.
segments.tr: N'importe laquelle de ces options nécessiterait une attention soutenue de la part de dirigeants qui ont jusqu'à présent traité la question comme une curiosité saisonnière.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: The clock-change debate persists because it combines wide public frustration with a real scientific and political disagreement.
segments.tr: Le débat sur le changement d'heure persiste parce qu'il combine une grande frustration du public avec un réel désaccord scientifique et politique.

segments.src: Ending the switch is easy to endorse.
segments.tr: Mettre fin au changement est facile à appuyer.

segments.src: Deciding which permanent time to choose, and who bears the cost of dark mornings or early sunsets, is much harder.
segments.tr: Décider quelle heure permanente choisir, et qui subit le coût des matins sombres ou des couchers de soleil précoces, est beaucoup plus difficile.

segments.src: Until lawmakers settle that question, Americans can expect to keep adjusting their clocks twice a year, and to have this argument again each spring and fall.
segments.tr: Tant que les législateurs n'auront pas réglé cette question, les Américains peuvent s'attendre à continuer d'ajuster leurs horloges deux fois par an, et à réentendre cet argument chaque printemps et chaque automne.

segments.src: In March 2022 the Senate passed it by unanimous consent, with little debate.
segments.tr: Em março de 2022, o Senado a aprovou por consentimento unânime, com pouco debate.

segments.src: The bill would have made daylight saving time permanent nationwide.
segments.tr: O projeto de lei teria tornado o horário de verão permanente em todo o país.

segments.src: The House did not take it up, and the bill expired at the end of that session.
segments.tr: A Câmara não o votou, e o projeto caducou no final daquela sessão.

segments.src: Versions have been reintroduced in later Congresses with bipartisan sponsors, and they have again stalled in committee.
segments.tr: Versões foram reintroduzidas em Congressos posteriores com patrocinadores bipartidários, e elas novamente travaram no comitê.

segments.src: The 2022 episode is often cited as proof of how popular the idea is.
segments.tr: O episódio de 2022 é frequentemente citado como prova de quão popular a ideia é.

segments.src: It also showed how little consensus lay beneath the surface.
segments.tr: Ele também mostrou quão pouco consenso havia sob a superfície.

segments.src: Several senators later said they had not examined the details, and some critics argued the chamber had acted without a serious look at the evidence.
segments.tr: Vários senadores disseram mais tarde que não haviam examinado os detalhes, e alguns críticos argumentaram que a câmara agiu sem uma análise séria das evidências.

segments.src: ## The Case for Permanent Daylight Time
segments.tr: ## Os Argumentos a Favor do Horário de Verão Permanente

segments.src: Supporters of year-round daylight time point to several benefits:
segments.tr: Os defensores do horário de verão o ano todo apontam vários benefícios:

segments.src: - **Evening light.** Later sunsets year-round mean more daylight after work and school, which supporters say encourages outdoor activity, shopping and recreation.
segments.tr: - **Luz à noitinha.** Pôr do sol mais tarde o ano todo significa mais luz do dia após o trabalho e a escola, o que, segundo os defensores, incentiva atividades ao ar livre, compras e recreação.

segments.src: - **Safety.** Some studies suggest that more evening light can reduce certain crimes and may lower the risk of pedestrian crashes during the evening commute, when traffic is heavy.
segments.tr: - **Segurança.** Alguns estudos sugerem que mais luz no final do dia pode reduzir certos crimes e pode diminuir o risco de atropelamentos de pedestres durante o trajeto de volta para casa, quando o tráfego é intenso.

segments.src: - **Economic activity.** Retail, restaurant and tourism groups have long backed extra daylight hours, arguing that consumers spend more when it is light out.
segments.tr: - **Atividade econômica.** Grupos de varejo, restaurantes e turismo há muito apoiam horas extras de luz do dia, argumentando que os consumidores gastam mais quando está claro.

segments.src: - **No more switching.** Ending the twice-yearly change removes the disruption it causes, including a short-term rise in some health and safety problems around the spring shift.
segments.tr: - **Chega de trocas.** Acabar com a mudança bianual remove a perturbação que ela causa, incluindo um aumento de curto prazo em alguns problemas de saúde e segurança em torno da mudança da primavera.

segments.src: ## The Case for Permanent Standard Time
segments.tr: ## Os Argumentos a Favor do Horário Padrão Permanente

segments.src: Many sleep scientists and medical groups favor the opposite approach.
segments.tr: Muitos cientistas do sono e grupos médicos favorecem a abordagem oposta.

segments.src: The American Academy of Sleep Medicine and other professional bodies have said that permanent standard time better matches the human body clock, because it aligns more closely with the natural cycle of sunrise and sunset.
segments.tr: A Academia Americana de Medicina do Sono e outros órgãos profissionais disseram que o horário padrão permanente se alinha melhor ao relógio biológico humano, porque se alinha mais de perto com o ciclo natural do nascer e do pôr do sol.

segments.src: Their main points are:
segments.tr: Seus principais pontos são:

segments.src: - **Circadian health.** Standard time puts more light in the morning, which helps regulate sleep and alertness. Permanent daylight time would mean very late sunrises in winter, especially in the western parts of time zones. In some places the sun would not rise until well after 8 a.m.
segments.tr: - **Saúde circadiana.** O horário padrão coloca mais luz pela manhã, o que ajuda a regular o sono e o estado de alerta. O horário de verão permanente significaria amanheceres muito tardios no inverno, especialmente nas partes ocidentais dos fusos horários. Em alguns lugares, o sol só nasceria bem depois das 8h.

segments.src: - **Sleep and long-term health.** Researchers have linked chronic misalignment between social clocks and the body clock with sleep loss and other health problems. Advocates say standard time is the safer bet.
segments.tr: - **Sono e saúde a longo prazo.** Pesquisadores associaram o desalinhamento crônico entre os relógios sociais e o relógio biológico à perda de sono e a outros problemas de saúde. Defensores dizem que o horário padrão é a aposta mais segura.

segments.src: - **School mornings.** Children would commonly wait for buses and walk to school in the dark during winter months under permanent daylight time.
segments.tr: - **Manhãs escolares.** As crianças normalmente esperariam pelos ônibus e caminhariam para a escola no escuro durante os meses de inverno sob o horário de verão permanente.

segments.src: Evidence on both sides is real but imperfect.
segments.tr: As evidências de ambos os lados são reais, mas imperfeitas.

segments.src: Studies vary in method and in geography, and a benefit in one region can be a cost in another.
segments.tr: Os estudos variam em método e em geografia, e um benefício em uma região pode ser um custo em outra.

segments.src: ## Lessons From the Past
segments.tr: ## Lições do Passado

segments.src: The United States has tried this before.
segments.tr: Os Estados Unidos já tentaram isso antes.

segments.src: In 1974, Congress enacted year-round daylight time as a response to the energy crisis.
segments.tr: Em 1974, o Congresso promulgou o horário de verão o ano todo como resposta à crise energética.

segments.src: Early public support faded within months as winter mornings stayed dark, and Congress reversed course the following year.
segments.tr: O apoio público inicial desvaneceu-se em poucos meses com as manhãs de inverno permanecendo escuras, e o Congresso mudou de rumo no ano seguinte.

segments.src: Supporters of permanence say today's circumstances are different.
segments.tr: Os defensores da permanência dizem que as circunstâncias de hoje são diferentes.

segments.src: Critics say the episode is a warning.
segments.tr: Os críticos dizem que o episódio é um aviso.

segments.src: ## Why Nothing Gets Done
segments.tr: ## Por Que Nada é Feito

segments.src: If both parties like the idea of ending clock changes, why is there no law?
segments.tr: Se ambos os partidos gostam da ideia de acabar com as mudanças de horário, por que não há lei?

segments.src: Several obstacles stand in the way.
segments.tr: Vários obstáculos estão no caminho.

segments.src: 1. **A split over which time.** Ending the switch is popular, but people who want permanent daylight time and people who want permanent standard time often oppose each other more than they oppose the status quo. A bill that satisfies one camp can lose the other.
segments.tr: 1. **Uma divisão sobre qual horário.** Acabar com a mudança é popular, mas as pessoas que querem o horário de verão permanente e as que querem o horário padrão permanente geralmente se opõem mais umas às outras do que ao status quo. Um projeto de lei que satisfaz um campo pode perder o outro.

segments.src: 2. **Regional differences.** A sunrise at 8:30 a.m. is a minor matter in one part of a time zone and a serious one in another. Lawmakers from northern and western areas of a zone often have different priorities from those in the east.
segments.tr: 2. **Diferenças regionais.** Um nascer do sol às 8h30 é um assunto menor em uma parte de um fuso horário e grave em outra. Legisladores das áreas norte e oeste de um fuso frequentemente têm prioridades diferentes daqueles do leste.

segments.src: 3. **Competing priorities.** Time policy rarely ranks above budgets, security and health care on a crowded legislative calendar. Committee leaders may see it as a low-urgency item with high potential for backlash.
segments.tr: 3. **Prioridades concorrentes.** A política de horários raramente fica acima de orçamentos, segurança e saúde em um calendário legislativo lotado. Os líderes dos comitês podem ver isso como um item de baixa urgência com alto potencial de reação negativa.

segments.src: 4. **Industry and regional concerns.** Transportation, broadcasting, agriculture and finance all depend on time standards. Some businesses worry about misalignment with neighboring states or trading partners if states choose different paths.
segments.tr: 4. **Preocupações industriais e regionais.** Transporte, radiodifusão, agricultura e finanças dependem de padrões de tempo. Algumas empresas se preocupam com o desalinhamento com estados vizinhos ou parceiros comerciais se os estados escolherem caminhos diferentes.

segments.src: 5. **Fear of repeating 1974.** Lawmakers remember that a popular change was reversed once voters felt the effects.
segments.tr: 5. **Medo de repetir 1974.** Os legisladores lembram que uma mudança popular foi revertida assim que os eleitores sentiram os efeitos.

segments.src: ## The Statehouse Picture
segments.tr: ## O Cenário nas Legislaturas Estaduais

segments.src: States keep acting even though they cannot finish the job.
segments.tr: Os estados continuam agindo, mesmo não podendo concluir o trabalho.

segments.src: Some legislatures have passed daylight-time trigger laws.
segments.tr: Algumas legislaturas aprovaram leis de gatilho para o horário de verão.

segments.src: Others have considered bills for permanent standard time, which they are already allowed to adopt.
segments.tr: Outras consideraram projetos de lei para o horário padrão permanente, que já têm permissão para adotar.

segments.src: A few have proposed regional compacts so that neighboring states move together.
segments.tr: Alguns propuseram pactos regionais para que estados vizinhos ajam juntos.

segments.src: Each approach has trade-offs, and none solves the national question alone.
segments.tr: Cada abordagem tem concessões, e nenhuma resolve a questão nacional sozinha.

segments.src: ## What Could Break the Logjam
segments.tr: ## O Que Poderia Desatar o Nó

segments.src: Possible paths include:
segments.tr: Os caminhos possíveis incluem:

segments.src: - **A compromise bill** that lets each state choose between permanent standard and permanent daylight time, with rules to limit confusion at borders.
segments.tr: - **Um projeto de lei de compromisso** que permita a cada estado escolher entre o horário padrão e o horário de verão permanentes, com regras para limitar a confusão nas fronteiras.

segments.src: - **A federal study** that gathers current evidence on health, safety and economic effects before Congress commits.
segments.tr: - **Um estudo federal** que colete evidências atuais sobre efeitos na saúde, segurança e economia antes de o Congresso se comprometer.

segments.src: - **Movement on standard time first**, since states can already adopt it without federal approval, which could build experience and data.
segments.tr: - **Movimento primeiro no horário padrão**, já que os estados já podem adotá-lo sem aprovação federal, o que poderia construir experiência e dados.

segments.src: Any of these would require sustained attention from leaders who have so far treated the issue as a seasonal curiosity.
segments.tr: Qualquer uma dessas opções exigiria atenção sustentada de líderes que até agora trataram o assunto como uma curiosidade sazonal.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Resumo

segments.src: The clock-change debate persists because it combines wide public frustration with a real scientific and political disagreement.
segments.tr: O debate sobre a mudança de horário persiste porque combina ampla frustração pública com um verdadeiro desacordo científico e político.

segments.src: Ending the switch is easy to endorse.
segments.tr: Acabar com a troca é fácil de endossar.

segments.src: Deciding which permanent time to choose, and who bears the cost of dark mornings or early sunsets, is much harder.
segments.tr: Decidir qual horário permanente escolher e quem arca com o custo de manhãs escuras ou pores do sol precoces é muito mais difícil.

segments.src: Until lawmakers settle that question, Americans can expect to keep adjusting their clocks twice a year, and to have this argument again each spring and fall.
segments.tr: Até que os legisladores resolvam essa questão, os americanos podem esperar continuar ajustando seus relógios duas vezes por ano e ter essa discussão novamente a cada primavera e outono.
